subject: Next steps & milestone plan for HelixCare pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@helixcare.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@helixcare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & milestone plan for HelixCare pilot

Hannah / Tom —

Thanks again for the run-through today. Quick recap from our side and suggested mutual action plan so we can align on owners, success criteria, and dates. Key takeaways: 

- Pain: Core triage team needs faster routing and fewer false positives on urgent cases; current average time-to-triage is ~12 minutes.
- Goal: Reduce triage latency to under 3 minutes for 90% of urgent items and improve precision for priority classification to >=85%.
- Scope for pilot: Two clinical queues (ED intake and urgent follow-ups), Redwood inference runtime in HelixCare VPC, telemetry into your Splunk instance.

Suggested milestones (first pass):
1) Pilot kickoff & architecture review — target week of Aug 7 — Owner: Marcus (Redwood) & Tom (HelixCare).
2) Security & compliance sign-off (SOC2 scoping, network configs) — target Aug 14 — Owner: Monica (Redwood) & Procurement/IT (HelixCare).
3) Data ingestion & prompt mapping (sample 2 weeks of triage logs) — target Aug 21 — Owner: HelixCare data eng.
4) Pilot deploy (VPC private control plane) — target Sep 4 — Owner: Redwood infra.
5) 2-week validation & quality check (metrics: latency, precision) — target Sep 18 — Owners: joint.

Action items we can take this week:
- I will send a one-page Mutual Action Plan (attached) with explicit owners/dates and a DocuSign link for signature.
- Monica will attach our security questionnaire answers that map to the SOC2 items you asked about.
- Tom, can you confirm the procurement contact and whether there is an internal SSO policy we need to account for?

If this looks right, we'll issue the MPA and a proposed SOW stub tomorrow morning so procurement has something to review.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Next steps & milestone plan for HelixCare pilot

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear summary. This matches our internal notes. Two quick things from my side:

1) Procurement contact is procurement@helixcare.com (CC'd here) — they will need an estimated cost range and a draft SOW.
2) For security: we require a standard questionnaire and evidence of encryption-in-transit + customer-managed KMS for private deployments. If you can flag those in the MPA that would be great.

We'll aim to have the sample logs ready by Aug 15; I'll confirm once the data team finishes a scrub.

Also, can you include a short success metric table in the MPA showing the baseline and target for latency & precision? That makes it easier to get clinical sign-off.

Appreciate it — Hannah
Hannah Cole
Head of Clinical Ops | HelixCare
hannah.cole@helixcare.com | +1 617-555-3446

Subject: Fwd: Next steps & milestone plan for HelixCare pilot (security)

Marc / Aditya —

Looping back with the security attachments referenced in Marcus's note. I attached the Security_QA_Responses_20280725.docx which maps our answers to the SOC2 areas Hannah flagged and calls out:

- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest; option for customer-managed KMS in Private deployment.
- Access & audit: Token-level audit logs and per-route tracing stored for 90 days by default (configurable).
- Data residency: VPC deployment keeps data within customer network; no model training on customer data.

I also sketched a short success metric table you can paste into the MPA:

Baseline | Target
Latency (median triage) | 12m | <3m (90th percentile target)
Precision (priority label) | 64% | >=85%
Throughput | 150 req/min | 200 req/min sustained during peak

I'll mark the MPA (attached) with Monica (Redwood) as the compliance owner and add procurement@helixcare.com as the procurement reviewer. If procurement wants a formalized SOW, we can produce a stub that maps to the milestones above.

-- Monica Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-2701
